What "from" means

"From" is the price of the package as described above. If your project needs more, you get a fixed price for it before we start, never an open-ended bill. External costs, such as a domain name (usually about €10 to €25 a year), platform fees or Apple and Google developer accounts, are listed in your quote. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

Frequently asked questions

Do your prices include VAT?

Our prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added. What you see in the quote is what you pay for our work. External costs, such as a domain name, store accounts or payment provider fees, are paid directly to those parties and are listed in the quote up front.

How do I pay?

For apps, in three parts: 40% when you approve the quote, 40% when you approve the test version and 20% on delivery. That way you never pay everything up front and always see results first. For smaller jobs, such as a website or automation, the payment terms are stated in the quote. All prices are final prices in euros.

Can I see something before I pay?

Yes. You get a free concept within 48 hours, designed specifically for your business, with no obligation. Only if you like it do we make a fixed price. If it is not for you, you have paid nothing and are not committed to anything.

Do you work with clients outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, with clients worldwide, in English or Dutch. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere, with no VAT added. Time zones are rarely a problem: most of the work is done in writing, and calls are planned at a time that suits you.
